title: Thunder over the Tomatoes
subtitle: Henry keeps Leo cozy until the storm rolls past.

levels.title: The Cozy Spot Thief
levels.clue: Leo has claimed Henry's blanket spot—just as the first thunder rumbles.

levels.title: Tuck In, Leo
levels.clue: Match beside the blanket to spread it over Leo's shivery side.

levels.title: Henry Brings a Slipper
levels.clue: Henry fetches a slipper that smells like Mom. The blanket grows.

levels.title: Ladybug Delivery
levels.clue: Guide Henry across the sunroom to bring Leo his favorite ladybug.

levels.title: Rain on the Windows
levels.clue: Raindrops drum on the glass. Keep the blanket spreading.

levels.title: A Snack for Courage
levels.clue: Leo is too nervous to eat—unless Henry shares his snack.

levels.title: The Loudest Clap
levels.clue: The biggest boom yet. Henry pulls the blanket wider.

levels.title: Every Comfort Thing
levels.clue: Henry carries every favorite toy to Leo, one trip at a time.

levels.title: Rumbles Fading
levels.clue: The thunder rolls farther away. Just a little more blanket.

levels.title: Sharing the Blanket
levels.clue: The storm passes. Spread the blanket wide enough for two.
